features.name: age
features.description: Adult Census variable: age of the person. In this repository it is already stored as a numeric processed feature.

features.name: workclass
features.description: Adult Census variable: employment type or work class, such as private, government, self-employed, or without pay. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: fnlwgt
features.description: Adult Census variable: final sampling weight, representing how many people in the population the record is estimated to represent.

features.name: education
features.description: Adult Census variable: highest education category, such as high school, bachelors, masters, doctorate, and related categories. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: education_num
features.description: Adult Census variable: numeric years or level of education corresponding to the education category.

features.name: marital_status
features.description: Adult Census variable: marital status category, such as married, divorced, separated, widowed, or never married. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: occupation
features.description: Adult Census variable: occupation category, such as technical support, craft repair, sales, executive managerial, professional specialty, service, or farming fishing. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: relationship
features.description: Adult Census variable: household relationship category, such as husband, wife, own child, not in family, unmarried, or other relative. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: race
features.description: Adult Census variable: race category. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: sex
features.description: Adult Census variable: sex category. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: capital_gain
features.description: Adult Census variable: capital gains income reported for the person. In this repository it is stored as a numeric processed feature.

features.name: capital_loss
features.description: Adult Census variable: capital losses reported for the person. In this repository it is stored as a numeric processed feature.

features.name: hours_per_week
features.description: Adult Census variable: usual hours worked per week. In this repository it is stored as a numeric processed feature.

features.name: native_country
features.description: Adult Census variable: country of origin. In this repository it is encoded numerically.

features.name: income
features.description: Prediction target for the Adult Census task: whether annual income is above the dataset threshold, usually represented as greater than 50K versus not greater than 50K.
